title: Wrap / group / columns via replace
when_to_use: User wants to group blocks, wrap in columns/group/row, or unwrap — without a dedicated wrap ability.
principles: There is no wrap-blocks / ungroup-blocks ability — compose with replace-blocks (or set-blocks for large rebuilds).
Wrap: replace the selected refs with a parent block (core/group, core/columns + core/column, etc.) whose innerBlocks are the previous blocks (preserve names/attrs/inners).
Ungroup: replace the parent ref with its former innerBlocks at the same position.
Prefer replace-blocks on the affected refs over rewriting the entire document.
steps: get-selection or get-blocks to capture the refs and full block trees to wrap/unwrap.
Build the new tree (parent with innerBlocks, or flattened inners) as real {name, attributes, innerBlocks} objects.
replace-blocks with those refs and the new tree.
anti_patterns: set-blocks for the whole page when only a small selection needs wrapping.
